items.desc_en: Initial reports from a post-mortem said he had "abrasions on his back and chest", investigators say.
items.desc_zh: 调查人员称，初步尸检报告称，他“背部和胸部有擦伤”。

items.title_en: Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
items.title_zh: 卡莉·西蒙透露帕金森病的诊断结果
items.desc_en: The singer also reveals she has received treatment for skin cancer, but vows to keep singing.
items.desc_zh: 这位歌手还透露，她已经接受了皮肤癌的治疗，但发誓要继续唱歌。

items.title_en: Steve Eisman is starting to have doubts about AI. The 'Big Short' investor just sold a key tech stock
items.title_zh: 史蒂夫·艾斯曼开始对人工智能产生怀疑。 “大空头”投资者刚刚出售了一只关键科技股
items.desc_en: Steve Eisman is warning that investors may be underestimating the risks if the AI boom fails to deliver on lofty expectations.
items.desc_zh: 史蒂夫·艾斯曼警告说，如果人工智能的繁荣未能实现崇高的期望，投资者可能会低估风险。

items.title_en: Anger, shock and grief - questions remain in the wake of the Berlin Pride attack
items.title_zh: 愤怒、震惊和悲伤——柏林骄傲袭击事件后问题依然存在
items.desc_en: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.
items.desc_zh: 随着柏林骄傲节袭击者的过去的细节浮出水面，许多人都在问他为什么没有入狱。

items.title_en: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
items.title_zh: 巴厘岛禁止荷兰外籍人士经营俱乐部，据称该俱乐部排除了印度尼西亚人
items.desc_en: The two men, who are accused of favouring foreigners for their events, allegedly violated immigration laws.
items.desc_zh: 这两个人被指控在活动中偏袒外国人，据称违反了移民法。

items.title_en: Why budding birders are flocking to Shazam-like apps to identify avians
items.title_zh: 为什么新晋观鸟者纷纷涌向类似 Shazam 的应用程序来识别鸟类
items.desc_en: Birdwatchers tell the BBC how apps have changed their lifelong hobby - and attracted new birders.
items.desc_zh: 观鸟者告诉 BBC，应用程序如何改变了他们一生的爱好，并吸引了新的观鸟者。

items.title_en: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
items.title_zh: 西雅图太空针塔附近美食节发生枪击事件 造成三人死亡、多人受伤
items.desc_en: Several others, including a two-year-old boy, were also injured. Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson says a suspect is in custody.
items.desc_zh: 其他几人也受伤，其中包括一名两岁男孩。西雅图市长凯蒂·威尔逊表示，一名嫌疑人已被拘留。

items.title_en: Google fined €890m by EU for favouring its own apps over rivals
items.title_zh: 谷歌因偏爱自己的应用而不是竞争对手而被欧盟罚款 8.9 亿欧元
items.desc_en: It is the first major enforcement action against the tech giant under the EU's new digital rules.
items.desc_zh: 这是欧盟新数字规则下针对这家科技巨头的首次重大执法行动。

items.title_en: Amazon gaming boss predicts future where players no longer need consoles
items.title_zh: 亚马逊游戏老板预测未来玩家将不再需要游戏机
items.desc_en: Jeff Gattis said the rising cost of gaming tech is likely to mean more people will stream their games online.
items.desc_zh: 杰夫·加蒂斯表示，游戏技术成本的上升可能意味着更多的人会在线玩游戏。

items.title_en: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
items.title_zh: 随着人工智能的恐惧加剧，埃隆·马斯克说：“让我们享受这段旅程吧”
items.desc_en: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.
items.desc_zh: 马斯克在接受《经济学人》采访时表示，他不在乎人们是否讨厌他，并表示他不是种族主义者。
